title: Sam's Music Discs
description:
Adds lots of Music Discs with various songs. These can be crafted, from fragments, or just by blocks.
Songs that include anything brainrot will not be added!
You can suggest songs on Discord, link down below...
body:
**WOW**
Everybody likes music... Anybody who is here probably likes Minecraft... 
Why not connect those 2 by adding your favourite music to Minecraft a Music Disc.

This mod adds lots of Music Disc to minecraft with possibly songs that are suggested by you, yes you, the person that's reading this right now.

"But where do I suggest a song I like?" you may ask...
Just go to our Discord, and there you can suggest songs, and we'll see if we approve them or reject them... Link below⬇️⬇️

List of song added by 2nd July 2025:

<details>
<summary>Songs</summary>

Version numbering system: 
- aX.X.X - Alpha (alpha means very little number of songs)
- bX.X.X - Beta (beta means a small change)
